description: This file implements helper functions for interacting with the Real Time Clock (RTC), including setting and getting time, formatting date strings, and initializing the RTC hardware. It includes conditional compilation for different environments and features.

methods.name: date_set_tm
methods.description: Sets the RTC date and time based on input struct tm pointer, converts to RTC-specific format and updates the hardware clock.

methods.name: date_get_tm
methods.description: Retrieves the current RTC date and time, converting from RTC-specific format into a struct tm.

methods.name: GetTimeUnixSec
methods.description: Returns the current time as a Unix timestamp if RTC is available; otherwise returns 0.

methods.name: SetTimeUnixSec
methods.description: Sets the RTC to a specified Unix timestamp after converting it to RTC date/time format.

methods.name: put2
methods.description: Formats an integer value into a string buffer at a specific offset, ensuring two-digit format.

methods.name: dateToStringShort
methods.description: Converts the current RTC date/time to a short string format, indicating if the RTC appears to have valid data.

methods.name: dateToString
methods.description: Formats the current RTC date/time into a detailed string representation.

methods.name: printDateTime
methods.description: Logs the current RTC time and status to a logging system.

methods.name: setDateTime
methods.description: Sets the RTC to a specified date/time given as a string representing Unix time.

methods.name: initRtc
methods.description: Initializes the RTC hardware and logs the initialization.
